title: Chapter 194 The Immortal Soul Ancestor
content:
Chapter 194 The Immortal Soul Ancestor

Nowadays, time flies, and the division of power in the Wood Immortal Realm has also undergone earth-shaking changes.

However, the Immortal Soul Sect has not been greatly affected because it has a terrifying late-stage Immortal Emperor.

Until today, it still stands proudly at the top of the Wood Immortal Realm, overlooking all living beings.

Therefore, the leader of the Immortal Soul Sect dared to openly stand up and point angrily at Wan Feng.

There is no way, the Immortal Soul Sect has been standing on the top for too long.

In their cognition, there is almost no existence in the Wood Immortal Realm that can fight against their Immortal Soul Sect.

Even if the Lord of the Desolate City made such a terrifying move, it is still difficult to change their position in their hearts.

Looking at the Immortal Soul Sect Lord's fearless appearance, the people of the surrounding forces were a little happy in their hearts.

For Wan Feng, no one present really wanted to please him.

What they really wanted to please was the Lord of the Desolate City.

That was the purpose of their coming.

As for the Crazy Emperor in front of him, your invincibility was a thing of the past, what does it have to do with now?

At this time, Wan Feng finally spoke slowly.

"I am indeed not the mayor of the deserted city."

Hearing this, everyone was slightly stunned. Is this a compromise?

If they had known it was so simple, they would have come up and sprayed it.

However, the next moment, Wan Feng suddenly changed his tone, and his voice instantly became extremely cold.

"But, forgive me for being blunt, you trash, in my eyes, saying that you are crooked is already a compliment."

As he said, Wan Feng looked at the leader of the Immortal Soul Sect with a cold gaze.

Suddenly, the leader of the Immortal Soul Sect suddenly trembled, and a strong fear arose from his heart.

Underestimate her!

"As for you, what do you think you can do if I kill you now?"

Boom!

The violent forbidden power suddenly surged out of Wan Feng's body without any warning.

In just a moment, the forbidden power covered the entire deserted city, including the area thousands of miles away.

Seeing this scene, someone in the field suddenly exclaimed.

"You, are you crazy?"

"You will destroy this place!"

They are very clear about the horror of this power.

When the Mad Emperor appeared, they had already started investigating.

Although there was very little information at the beginning, by now, they all know what they should know.

Including the special power of the Mad Emperor.

It was because of the horror of the special power of the Mad Emperor that the nine immortal emperors joined forces to kill him and finally sealed him.

Because this power is too domineering.

Nothing can stop this power. Once it gets out of control, the entire immortal world will suffer irreparable trauma.

To this day, the territory that sealed the Mad Emperor has been completely turned into a forbidden area due to the erosion of the forbidden power.

If a strong person below the Immortal Emperor enters, it will be corroded by the forbidden power in just a few breaths, and the seven orifices will bleed to death.

Although the strong people in the Immortal Emperor realm can resist the forbidden power for a short time, it will still be the same after a long time.

So at this moment, seeing Wan Feng releasing his forbidden power so unrestrainedly, everyone present suddenly changed their faces and stood up to leave.

And at this moment, a strong man suddenly noticed something wrong.

"Wait, look!"

Hearing the shout, everyone subconsciously stopped and looked intently.

I saw that the space that should have been corroded did not change at all. Seeing this scene, everyone was stunned for a moment, and then let go of their minds.

"Huh? I'm fine?"

"What's going on?"

After everyone was surprised, they looked puzzled. Didn't they say that the special power of the Mad Emperor was extremely terrifying?

How come nothing happened.

Could it be that the legend was exaggerated?

At this time, the field changed again.

Buzz——

I saw that the forbidden power that permeated the space suddenly began to condense regularly.

The next moment, a field composed of forbidden power surrounded everyone present with Wan Feng as the center.

Gah~

Everyone stared at this scene in amazement.

At this point, how could they still not understand.

"Domain! You have cultivated this power into a domain!!"

At this time, someone shouted in shock and told the truth.

With a bang.

The leader of the Immortal Soul Sect suddenly collapsed on the ground, trembling and pointing at Wan Feng, with an extremely ugly face.

"You, if you kill me, my Immortal Soul Sect ancestor will not let you go!"

This is the reason why he dared to confront the Mad Emperor head-on until now.

Because as far as he knew, his ancestor participated in the battle against the Mad Emperor, and his ancestor told him in person.

"What a bullshit Mad Emperor, it's just exaggerated by the world. That battle was easy, and I didn't even breathe."

Thinking of this, the leader of the Immortal Soul Sect suddenly felt much more at ease.

Since his ancestor is so powerful, there is nothing to be afraid of.

He struggled to stand up, but found his legs a little weak. Seeing this, the leader of the Immortal Soul Sect sat cross-legged on the spot.

"I tell you, if something happens to me, my ancestor will come immediately."

As he said this, the leader of the Immortal Soul Sect smiled.

"I think you haven't forgotten my ancestor."

Hearing this, everyone around was silent.

Because the strength of the ancestor of the Immortal Soul Sect is indeed terrifying, and he is also an old monster who has lived for endless years. This is a well-known fact.

However, Wan Feng sneered.

"Your ancestor? Is it the immortal soul ancestor who called eight people to hit me and finally started to fight him and hid on the side and watched?"

As soon as these words came out, everyone present was stunned.

You know, there are definitely not a few people staring at this moment.

If this news is true, it may shock the Wood Fairy World again.

"You fart!"

The leader of the Immortal Soul Sect immediately roared.

He didn't believe what Wan Feng said would be the truth. His ancestor was an invincible figure, so how could he do such a thing?

Upon hearing this, Wan Feng just sneered.

"Your ancestor knows this in his heart."

"But what's important now is that I want to kill you. Will your ancestor dare to stand up and stop him?"

As he said that, Wan Feng slowly raised his eyebrows and looked into the distance.

After three breaths, no breath appeared in the field. Seeing this, Wan Feng withdrew his gaze.

"Well, it seems you've been abandoned."

Hearing this, the leader of the Immortal Soul Sect was stunned and then burst into laughter.

"I am the leader of the Immortal Soul Sect. I was abandoned. Are you making fun of it?"

Seeing that the Sect Master of the Immortal Soul Sect was still alive in his own world, the rest of the people around him also began to shake their heads slightly.

The Immortal Soul Sect is ruined.

Seeing this, Wan Feng no longer talked nonsense.

I wanted to rely on this guy to lead out the lyb behind, but I didn't expect it to hide so deeply.

Since this is the case, the so-called Immortal Soul Sect leader is useless.
